rules.quote: Only Professional Degree Courses Eligible For Scholarships Are B.E./B.Tech, Integrated 5-Year Dual-Degree M.Tech, MBBS And LLB.
Only First-Year Applicants Beginning Their Studies In B.E., B.Tech, Integrated 5-Year Dual-Degree M.Tech ,MBBS And LLB Are Eligible.
Applicants Are Expected To Have Passed Their Higher Secondary / Pre-University / Intermediate / CBSE/ISC Or Equivalent Board Qualifying Examination After 2024.
Note: Diploma Students Admitted To B.E., B.Tech Courses On A Lateral Basis. B.Arch, BDS Students Are Not Eligible.

rules.value: JEE Main AIR up to 1,30,000 (northern states list); JEE Advanced up to 30,000 for IITs; state ranks 10,000 (TN/AP/MH/TS/KA), 4,000 (KL/GJ/WB/CG/BR), 1,000, 500
rules.quote: For students joining IITs, the additional eligibility criteria will be the Cut off Rank, at the JEE (Advanced) – General Category

rules.value: NEET overall rank up to 50,000 for MBBS
rules.quote: Applicants admitted based on NEET (Overall, All India General/Common Merit Rank – Not Category Rank)

rules.value: CLAT rank up to 7,000; state law CETs up to 2,500; others 1,000; CUET >65%

rules.quote: The gross family income criteria: Annual Income should be less than Rs 4.00 Lacs
Applicants who are the first graduates of the family will be preferred over applicants who are the second or third child of the family taking up graduation.

rules.quote: This assistance is available irrespective of the applicant’s caste, community, gender or religion.
